NEET UG Exam Format to Change for 2027

The National Testing Agency (NTA) is reportedly planning a significant overhaul of the NEET UG examination format starting in 2027. The proposed changes include shifting the exam to a computer-based test (CBT) and extending its duration over six days. Over 1,000 examination centers are expected to be utilized for the revamped test. This potential shift aims to address logistical challenges and improve the examination process.
